generation.kind: AI-assisted thumbnail design based on a frame of licensed real footage
generation.prompt: Edit the attached photographic woodland frame into a polished YouTube ambience thumbnail for Quiet Hours. Preserve the exact source photograph's woodland composition, tall warm-brown eucalyptus trunk at the far left, misty tree depth, dense green foliage, natural soft overcast light and all existing visual subjects. The photograph must remain recognizably the same real scene. Do not replace or redesign the forest, do not add birds, people, buildings, sunrays, lanterns or any new subject, and do not turn it into illustration. Keep the full landscape 16:9 composition. Only add the channel's graphic branding: huge, very tall condensed bold CREAM capital lettering in two stacked lines reading exactly 'FOREST' above 'DAWN', placed center-right with generous edge margins and a subtle dark shadow for excellent legibility on a phone. The cream title should be dominant and confidently sized, in the style of a premium condensed cinema poster, while the prominent left tree trunk remains unobscured. Above the title add a rounded warm metallic GOLD capsule badge with bold BLACK text reading exactly '1 HOUR'. Use a clean soft gold highlight and restrained dimensional shading for the capsule. No other text, logo, border or watermark. Match the established Night Rain/Quiet Shore channel identity through the cream condensed title and gold duration badge, not by changing this woodland to a porch or coastal scene. Output a landscape 16:9 thumbnail, ideally 1280x720.
